title: UK pushes ahead with temporary ban on political crypto donations
summary: The government plans to implement the ban by amending the Representation of the People Bill, with changes taking "retrospective effect" from March 25.

title: Coinbase opposes latest crypto bill stablecoin compromise: Report
summary: Coinbase is reportedly still pushing back against stablecoin yield provisions in the Senate’s crypto market structure bill, which has derailed past efforts to advance the legislation.

title: Proposed bill seeks to ban US president, Congress from prediction markets
summary: The bill adds to a wave of recent legislative and state-level actions targeting prediction markets as scrutiny over sports betting, war contracts and alleged insider trading builds.

title: Bitcoin’s quantum-resistance lag may become Ethereum’s bull case: Nic Carter
summary: Crypto entrepreneur Nic Carter claims that Bitcoin developers still have their "head in the sand" when it comes to making Bitcoin quantum-resistant, compared to Ethereum.

title: Swan Bitcoin seeks to subpoena Cantor Fitzgerald, ex-CEO in ex-staff dispute
summary: Swan Bitcoin claims that Howard Lutnick likely knew about its failed Tether mining venture, after which employees allegedly stole documents, resigned and launched a rival firm.

title: Australia's central bank backs tokenization as pilot finds $16.7B upside
summary: Tokenized finance and related infrastructure upgrades will be “revolutionary,” said Reserve Bank of Australia Assistant Governor Brad Jones.

title: Bitcoin Depot picks ex-MoneyGram boss as CEO as state actions mount
summary: Former MoneyGram veteran Alex Holmes is now leading Bitcoin Depot, as crypto ATM operators face mounting legal scrutiny in multiple US states.

title: Court rejects dev's bid to shield software from money transmitter laws
summary: Pharos developer Michael Lewellen said his lawyers are exploring all options for a path forward after a Texas judge dismissed the case without prejudice.

title: Google targets 2029 post-quantum migration as threats draw nearer
summary: Google has urged others to accelerate post-quantum efforts as it continues to develop Willow, one of the most powerful superconducting quantum processors today.

title: $18.6B in Bitcoin options expire Friday: Should traders prepare for $75K BTC?
summary: Bitcoin bulls face an uphill battle to turn the March options expiry in their favor, requiring a 6% price rally to $75,000 before Friday.
